# Audio regression fixtures

`RecordedDiFixtures.h` contains fixed 16-bit PCM captures rendered from TubeForge's
project-owned plucked-string capture model. The data is stored in source control so
regression tests compare stable guitar and bass DI snippets rather than regenerating
their inputs. The fixture data is released under the same license as TubeForge and may
be redistributed with the test suite.
